entities.summary: Gholam-Hossein Mohseni-Eje'i (Persian: غلام حسین محسنی اژه‌ای, romanized: Ğolām-Hoseyn Mohseni Eže'i, Persian pronunciation: [ɢolɒːmhoˈsejn mohseˈniː eʒeˈjiː] ; born 29 September 1956 is an Iranian politician and Islamic jurist who has served as the 8th chief justice of Iran since 2021. he also has previously headed the Iranian minister of intelligence from 2005 to July 2009, when he was abruptly dismissed. He also held a number of other governmental posts since 1984.
